# Honora Hollis & Nell Harcourt

- [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — close friends and driven scholars · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +14 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjust to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approach, balancing academic rivalry and friendships. Meanwhile, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues visiting [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and maintains a positive perspective on her studies and upcoming examinations.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit Daniel Blair.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) spend a spring Saturday exploring the woods and fields together. Along their path, they encounter a quiet pool they name [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and discover an abandoned, flower-filled garden. Sitting among the narcissi, Isolde tells the story of [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) and [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Wren, the couple who originally created the hidden garden.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Isolde finish talking about [Dinah Wren](../character/dinah-wren.md) before spending the rest of the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. They discuss nature, poetry, and what souls might look like before gathering narcissus blossoms and walking home at sunset.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P60](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0060), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

> While waiting in the duckhouse, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes down a garden conversation with Isolde's assistance. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp frees [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a hatchet, feeds the girls, and agrees to sell them her willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars, revealing she plans to get married. The girls then drive away with the platter along [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road).
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) depart for town, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) at home. While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) departs from [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after emotional goodbyes, traveling by train and ferry alongside Hugh and Wilfred. Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), she is greeted by [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), who escorts her to their new boardinghouse while chatting to brighten Nell's spirits.
>

> After enrolling at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery to escape their feelings of insignificance. While exploring the historic tombstones, they encounter [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), another lonely student, and quickly form a warm friendship with her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) chat with [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) in the cemetery about her origin, indecisiveness, potential suitors, and reasons for attending [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). After inspecting a historic midshipman's grave, they bid [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) farewell and discuss their positive impressions of her on their way home.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>

> [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Hugh, and Wilfred on a walk through the park and along [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). During their walk, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a quiet conversation about life and grief before the group stops to admire a quaint, historic cottage called Tabby's Place.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) reflect on their time in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) while walking back via [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). As they pass Tabby's Place, they discover a "To Let" sign and decide to inquire about renting it the following day despite Honora's doubts about the cost.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Tabby's Place and successfully arrange to rent the cottage from Miss Tabby Linden and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Later that night, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) visits their room and enthusiastically begs to join them as a housemate, to which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) agree pending Mabel's consent.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sits in the garden with Opal, who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her unfulfilled desires for her life. Shortly after, Opal passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home discussing death and the afterlife.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) claims [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) as her cat after Cressy's attempt to kill him fails. > [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) writes a letter to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describing her stay at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She recounts her health scares, introduces the eccentric older boarders, and shares her growing admiration and feelings for [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), an earnest young theology student.

> At Tabby's Place, the young women prepare for upcoming examinations while discussing their future plans and cooking skills. Later, during an evening walk in the park, [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) has proposed to her and she has accepted, reflecting on her past suitors and her devotion to him. Their conversation turns to Nell's own feelings toward [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).
>

> The girls return to Tabby's Place for their final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), sharing stories, teasing [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) about her past suitors, and settling back into their routine. Later, on a rainy night, [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) combat their study fatigue by reviewing old, dramatic [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales. Re-reading an old piece she wrote at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) feels inspired to take a new step.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Wexcombe Year Opens

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives news that her short story was accepted by a magazine, which she celebrates with her housemates at Tabby's Place. Later, during a walk, [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that his family will visit her, though they unexpectedly arrive a day early on Friday. The visit is full of awkward moments, including cats jumping on Mrs. Lisle and Aline accidentally sitting on Honora's hidden chocolate cake, though Cyril's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>
